jobs.title: PowerTel (POWERGRID) Trainee Engineer (Electronics) through GATE 2026: 33 Posts
jobs.summary: POWERGRID Teleservice Limited (PowerTel), a POWERGRID subsidiary, has notified 33 Trainee Engineer (Electronics) posts (Advt CC/04/2026) for B.E./B.Tech Electronics graduates with a GATE 2026 EC score. Apply online by 27 November 2026.
lines: Eligibility: Full-time B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg.) in Electronics, ECE, E&TC or Telecom with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA, plus a valid GATE 2026 EC score
Age: Maximum 28 years as on 27 Nov 2026 (OBC-NCL +3, SC/ST +5, PwBD +10)
Pay: Rs 30,000 - 1,20,000 (IDA) with HRA and perks; 1-year training, then Assistant Engineer (E0); 3-year service bond
Selection: GATE 2026 EC marks (85%), Group Discussion (3%), Personal Interview (12%), behavioural assessment, medical

jobs.title: MPSC Group C 2026 (Advt 017/2026): Vacancies Increased to 16,717 Posts
jobs.summary: MPSC has raised the Group C Services Combined Preliminary Examination 2026 vacancies from 5,707 to 16,717 across 27 cadres and reopened applications from 13 to 27 November 2026; earlier applicants can add the new cadres from their existing account.
lines: Eligibility: Clerk-Typist and Tax Assistant need a bachelor's degree plus a Marathi/English typing certificate; other cadres as per notification
Age: Maximum 38 years for open category, relaxation for reserved categories as per rules, plus 1 extra year (GR dated 5 Nov 2026)
Selection: Preliminary exam (100 questions, 100 marks, 1 hour, -1/4 per wrong answer), main exam, typing/skill test where required, document verification
Dates: apply 13 Nov - 27 Nov 2026; prelims 24 Jan 2027
